decisions.acceptance_1_superseded_dead_letters: DistillationJobQueue.resolve_superseded_dead_letters resolves any unresolved dead letter whose source has a newer outbox version in a terminal state (done, skipped, failed, dead_letter, or a newer version already re-opened for defect re-attempt) by closing the stale outbox/inbox row as skipped with 'superseded by newer version <job_id> (<status>)' and recording last_redrive_actor, last_redrive_note and resolved_at on distillation_dead_letters, bounded per tick (100/tick). redrive_lease_expired_dead_letters and redrive_extraction_unavailable_dead_letters resolve superseded older versions through the same helper
decisions.acceptance_1_extraction_unavailable_redr: DistillationJobQueue.redrive_extraction_unavailable_dead_letters and DistillationWorker.run_pending redrive newest-version hypothesis_extraction_unavailable dead letters only when hypothesis_extractor is configured, within the 400-call daily cap and per-record attempt limits (3/day, 6/total via ExtractionLedger.can_attempt). When no earlier call in the tick has proved the extractor is answering, run_pending probes with at most 1 dead letter first; if the extractor is still failing (unavailable), mark_retry_or_dead_letter returns a previously redriven extraction dead letter directly to status='dead_letter' with resolved_at=NULL (preserving redrive_count) and stops redriving further rows in that tick
decisions.acceptance_2_checked_in_defect_list: FIXED_DEFECT_REATTEMPT_OUTCOMES in services/source_ingestion/hypothesis_card.py checks in the eligible defect outcomes and the fix that made each obsolete: (1) adapter_anyof_schema_mismatch -> L2-HYPOTHESIS-CARD-ADAPTER-SCHEMA-CONTRACT-20261126 (#7896), (2) prompt_unstated_abstention_max_length -> L2-HYPOTHESIS-CARD-ADAPTER-SCHEMA-CONTRACT-20261126 (#7896), (3) client_interactive_token_budget_breach -> L2-HYPOTHESIS-CARD-TOKEN-BUDGET-AND-USAGE-20261126 (#7908). fixed_defect_for_skip_reason requires prefix 'hypothesis_extraction_failed:' and never matches l2_irrelevant, l2_admission_denied, no_hypothesis, hypothesis_rejected, pre-call input budget_breach, >3072 output budget_breach, or unfixed schema/JSON errors
decisions.acceptance_2_ordered_once_behind_fresh: distillation_outbox gains additive column defect_reattempted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 and partial index distillation_outbox_defect_reattempt_idx. DistillationJobQueue.reattempt_fixed_defect_records re-opens only newest-version skipped rows with defect_reattempted=0 matching FIXED_DEFECT_REATTEMPT_OUTCOMES and stamps defect_reattempted=1 so each record is re-attempted at most once. DistillationWorker.run_pending processes all due fresh records in Phase 1 before re-opening defect-closed records in Phase 2, and claim_due ranks defect_reattempted=0 ahead of defect_reattempted=1 across ticks and budget deferrals

acceptance_2_hosted_backlog_calls_and_da.notes: 130 sources need 130 calls (1 re-attempt per newest version), which is 32.5% of one day's 400-call daily cap and drains in 1 day alongside up to 270 fresh relevant records (45-130 controller ticks at 120 s tick extraction budget), or 1-2 days if fresh relevant volume exceeds 270 calls on day 1; worst-case with transient provider timeouts is bounded by the existing 3/day (<=390 calls on day 1) and 6/total per-record limits over at most 2 days
